name: dwn2erth
description: dwn2erth is an interdisciplinary designer, with a current focus on visual art and interactive media. Driven by curiosity, play and experimentation, she moves between different mediums, looking for common ground. Her current aesthetics revolve around maximalism, glitchy, cyber chaos. Every piece of knowledge brings the possibility to create around it. She exhibits at the Artist Cohort and helps run the Onchain Art Hub, so tag along and find out more straight from the source. ｡𖦹°‧⋆˚࿔
